The '''Tavitz system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Reena Province]] under the control of [[House Reena/Legends|House Reena]]. It was an endpoint of the [[Caloria Run/Legends|Caloria Run]].
